title: Real yoyos: tether, cursor control, visible string, head model
player_outcome: Holding the button keeps the yoyo out on a visible string, spinning and following the cursor within its range, grinding enemies. Releasing reels it back. Each yoyo has Terraria's range and hang time.
design: Verified: wood_yoyo is a returning projectile (returns 40, lifetime 120). Only bobbers draw lines (ProjectileRenderer.cs:193-205).
ProjectileDef.Tether = TetherDef { Kind ('yoyo' | 'flail'), Range (cells), Lifetime (ticks, 0 = until release), Speed (m/s), String (hex) }. Validate the kind and positive ranges.
PlayerEntity.UseHeld, set every physics tick by InteractionController from use_primary.

New Core ProjectileSystem.Tethers.cs, TickYoyo: while owner.UseHeld and within lifetime, steer toward AimPoint clamped to Range from Eye (acceleration 60 m/s², capped at Speed). Move with VoxelMotion.Move so it never ends on terrain. Clear HitNpcs every 10 ticks, then call HitCreatures. Otherwise set Returning (existing return path).
TickSpecial dispatches on Def.Tether. Add TetherOf(PlayerEntity) for presentation.
MaxActive 1 (from P3-09): pressing again while the yoyo is out is a silent no-op.
New game/Entities/ProjectileRenderer.Tethers.cs: a string from the hand 'string' socket (P3-06 3P / P3-07 FP) to the yoyo as a thin camera-facing strip. The yoyo spins about its axle (roll 25 rad/s).
The held yoyo model is hidden while the yoyo is out.
Animation: PlayerAvatar calls Hold('yoyo') while TetherOf(entity) is a yoyo; the FP arm stays extended.
files_modify: game/Player/PlayerAvatar.Held.cs — hide held yoyo while out
data_changes: data/items/arsenal.json and data/items/lunar.json yoyo projectiles (wood_yoyo, rally, amazon, code_1, terrarian_yoyo): drop 'returns'; add tether {kind: yoyo, range, lifetime, speed} with Terraria values (Wooden Yoyo ≈ 3 s, Rally 5 s, Amazon 7 s, Code 1 9 s, Terrarian unlimited — confirm ranges against the wiki); model '<id>_head'; spin 25 roll; pierce -1
tests: YoyoTests: with UseHeld the yoyo stays alive for its lifetime and within Range of the Eye while AimPoint is far away
YoyoTests: releasing → removed within 120 ticks; a dummy in range takes ≥ 3 hits in 60 ticks
Smoke combat.cmds: 'give wood_yoyo 1' / 'wield wood_yoyo' / 'spawn zombie 1 3' / 'aim 0 0 1' / 'press use_primary on' / 'wait 0.6' / 'assert projectiles.count == 1'
Smoke combat.cmds, continued: 'wait 1.5' / 'press use_primary off' / 'wait 2' / 'assert projectiles.count == 0' / 'assert npcs.zombie == 0'
verification: dotnet test; Strata.Tools validate (projectile models exist from P3-05)
Lavapipe screenshot with the string visible in 3P and FP
risks: The aim point in 3P depends on P1's aim ray.
Hit cadence must use the per-projectile HitNpcs clear (local immunity), not NPC melee immunity.
